raw_description:
Job Title: Dental Billing & Insurance Virtual Assistant

Position type: Part-time | 20 hours per week
Location: Remote - Philippines
Pay Rate: 5-6 USD/hour
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday: 12:00 PM-4:00 PM PT

About the Client and Role

Our client is a U.S.-based dental practice focused on providing comprehensive dental care with an emphasis on preserving patients' oral health.

The practice is looking for an experienced Dental Virtual Assistant who can support dental billing, insurance coordination, and revenue cycle management while maintaining professional, compassionate communication with patients.

Key Responsibilities1. Insurance Follow-Ups & Claim Resolution (Primary)

- Make outbound calls to dental insurance companies regarding outstanding claims, denials, and payment issues.
- Investigate claim statuses, payment discrepancies, and unresolved billing concerns.
- Follow up with insurance representatives to clarify claim processing and payment information.
- Communicate with patients regarding insurance-related billing questions and concerns.
- Support end-to-end revenue cycle management and billing follow-up activities.

2. Dental Billing & EOB Processing

- Assist with dental billing workflows and insurance payment reconciliation.
- Review and process Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
- Coordinate with the on-site team regarding paper EOBs that may need to be scanned before virtual processing.
- Identify billing discrepancies and follow up on outstanding payment issues.
- Support accurate billing documentation and administrative follow-ups.

3. Insurance Verification & Accounts Receivable Management

- Verify and reconfirm patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits with insurance companies.
- Coordinate with the existing staff member responsible for insurance verification.
- Contact patients and insurance providers to clarify coverage and billing information.
- Monitor and follow up on outstanding accounts receivable (A/R).
- Assist with resolving unpaid balances and insurance-related payment concerns.

Additional Responsibilities (As Needed)

- Assist with appointment scheduling, cancellations, and rescheduling.
- Send patient text messages and handle appointment-related communications.
- Follow up on automated appointment reminders to double-confirm appointments.
- Assist with dental prior authorization requests and follow-ups.
- Make outbound patient calls and support administrative backend tasks.
- Provide occasional front-desk and receptionist support during overflow periods or when additional assistance is needed.

Workload Context: The practice sees approximately 16 patients on a busy day and receives around one inbound phone call per hour. Most of the VA's time will be dedicated to billing, insurance follow-ups, and RCM rather than routine inbound receptionist duties.

- Proven experience supporting U.S.-based dental practices.
- Hands-on experience with dental billing and insurance follow-ups.
- Experience reviewing and handling dental EOBs.
- Knowledge of dental insurance verification, eligibility, and benefits.
- Familiarity with insurance claim denials, payment issues, and accounts receivable workflows.
- Comfortable making outbound calls to insurance companies and discussing billing concerns with patients.
- Ability to work independently and adapt quickly to established workflows.
- Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- A positive, compassionate, diligent, and professional approach to patient interactions.
- Strong integrity and a genuine commitment to providing excellent patient service.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using Dentrix Ascend.
- Experience using Weave for patient communications.
- Familiarity with Delta Dental insurance processes.
- Broader healthcare administration experience.
- Experience supporting end-to-end dental revenue cycle management.

Basic Requirements

- Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant work experience.
- Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
